properties.name: Jalan Tebrau spine
properties.rationale: Follows Federal Route 3 (Jalan Tebrau, then Jalan Pandan and Jalan Kota Tinggi), the road the official 'Tebrau' name and the congestion claim refer to. Serves the Pelangi/KSL retail cluster and Tebrau City (AEON, IKEA, Toppen), ending at Desa Tebrau. Wide trunk reserve for most of its length.

properties.name: FT3 with Taman Molek deviation
properties.rationale: Same FT3 spine as T1, but leaves Jalan Pandan to run through Taman Molek (dense residential) on Jalan Persiaran Molek Utama before rejoining at Tebrau City. Tests whether a deviation into a residential core is worth the extra length.

properties.name: Jalan Tebrau to Mount Austin
properties.rationale: Same FT3 spine as T1 to Tebrau City, then turns west on Jalan Mutiara Emas Utama to end in Mount Austin (high-rise residential and commercial growth area) instead of Desa Tebrau.

properties.name: Eastern Dispersal Link (E14) reserve
properties.rationale: Tested because the existing elevated Eastern Dispersal Link (E14) reserve could host a guideway. Rejected if walk catchments and bus interchange are poorer than the FT3 options; metrics are computed so the rejection rests on numbers.

properties.name: Larkin - Kangkar Tebrau - Mount Austin
properties.rationale: Rejected on scope: Larkin belongs to the Skudai-Tampoi-Larkin corridor (out of scope, owner decision 2). Geometry is computed only to show the rejection; it is not a Skudai option.

properties.name: Coastal direct to Puteri Harbour and Kota Iskandar
properties.rationale: Shortest reserve from Bukit Chagar to the Iskandar Puteri administrative center, along the coastal roads (J1 and the Iskandar Coastal Highway). Expected to exceed the reported 14.78 km; the deviation itself is a finding.

properties.name: Coastal to Perling and Bukit Indah
properties.rationale: Ends at Bukit Indah, the largest established residential and retail center in Iskandar Puteri, instead of the administrative core. Tests which endpoint is consistent with the reported 14.78 km.

properties.name: Coastal - Bukit Indah - Medini - Kota Iskandar loop-free extension
properties.rationale: Serves both Bukit Indah and Kota Iskandar. Longest option; tests the coverage-versus-length trade-off.
